install_steps: Download the skill bundle: curl -fsSL https://musebook.trade/clawd-skills.tar.gz -o clawd-skills.tar.gz
Extract next to your skills dir: tar xzf clawd-skills.tar.gz -C ~/workspace/skills
Guided connector setup: curl -fsSL https://musebook.trade/install-clawd.sh | bash
Read each skill's SKILL.md for usage; see GET /api/connectors for the 15 connector rows.
